description: ignorePaths overrides config:recommended's :ignoreModulesAndTests, which ignores **/examples/** — an example plugin's dependencies get update PRs like any other manifest here

packageRules.description: The host's own runtime deps. Release-Bump is opt-in per surface (README → CI/CD): updateType rates the dependency's own jump, not whether it reaches a running Plainpages
The shipped image's base — e2e-tests/Dockerfile is test-only
The production topology — compose.override.yml is dev, e2e-tests/compose.*.yml are test

The production sidecars, wherever they are pinned — compose.yml and the published quick start move in one branch, so the trailer must not depend on which upgrade sorts first. mailpit is dev-only and stays out

node is pinned to one version across Dockerfile, dev, E2E and CI, so Renovate moves them in a single branch whose commitBody would otherwise depend on upgrade order — the Dockerfile copy ships, so any node bump is a product change
Ory services share one release train - update kratos, keto and hydra together
Playwright runner and its browser image are version-locked - bump together

customManagers.description: Pin the Renovate image the Renovate workflow runs
The published quick start ships a compose file, so its sidecars move with the repo's own pins. The version group starts at a digit, which skips the {{VERSION}} placeholder the release renders
Pin the node image workflow run-steps invoke (registry-cleanup, renovate auto-release, release)
